g24-0: A specific Korean dish. A generic word (국물, 고기, 한식) is a new answer, not a dish slot.
g24-1: 자장면 = 짜장면. Different dishes stay different (짬뽕 ≠ 짜장면).
g24-2: A fruit name alone means that fruit's juice (사과 = 사과 주스).
g24-3: Activity level. Movies (영화감상) are not TV/YouTube; Pilates/yoga is not 헬스 if a yoga/pilates slot exists; a specific sport is its own answer unless a slot names it.
g24-4: A specific sport the person does. 러닝 = 조깅/달리기, 헬스 = 웨이트. e-sports is not a sport you do here: new answer.
g24-9: A specific mountain. A generic hill (뒷동산) is a new answer.
g24-10: A dog breed. 비숑/Bichon/Bishong = 비숑 프리제, 골드리트리버 = 골든 리트리버, 푸들 = 토이 푸들, 몰티즈 = 말티즈.
g24-11: A cat breed. A coat colour (치즈고양이, 고등어) is a new answer.
g24n-0: A number. Only the exact same number matches.
g24n-1: A month. Only the exact same month matches (2월 ≠ 12월).
g24n-2: A day of the week. 수 = 수요일, Fri = 금요일.
g24n-3: A sport people watch. If two sports are named, use the first. A word like 관람 alone is not an answer (-2).
g26-0: Only the 10 KBO teams. Old names count as the current team: SK/SK 와이번스 → SSG 랜더스, 넥센/히어로즈 → 키움, 해태 → KIA, 빙그레 → 한화, OB → 두산, MBC/엘지 → LG, 기아 = KIA. Foreign teams (LA 다저스 etc.) are not an answer (-2).
g26-1: A company. Products count as their maker: ChatGPT → 오픈AI, Gemini/DeepMind → 구글, Claude/엔트로픽/앤트로픽 → Anthropic (new answer if no slot), 갤럭시 → 삼성전자.
ai-1: A specific food. 부침개/전 = 파전 only if no closer slot; 수제비 ≠ 칼국수; a generic word (국물음식) is a new answer.
ai-2: An item bought at a convenience store. A store name (이마트, GS25) is not an answer (-2). 사탕 = 초콜릿/사탕, not 과자.
ai-3: An action. 자기/잠/자다 = 잠자기/낮잠; 멍때리기 ≠ 잠자기; 단 거/간식 먹기 = 간식 먹기; 소리지르기 is its own answer.
ai-4: What to do with the pay. 외식 = 친구와 외식하기, 음식/맛있는 거 = 맛있는 음식 먹기, 카드값 = 빚 갚기. 빠른 퇴근 is not saving: new answer.
ai-5: What to do with the money. 은행 가기 is a new answer unless it clearly means saving.
ai-6: A nagging phrase, matched by meaning. 돈 얼마 모았니 is about savings, not salary: new answer. 살 = 살 좀 빼라.
ai-7: A nagging phrase, matched by meaning. 밥 = 식사 제때 챙겨 먹어라, 자라 = 잠 더 자라 only if it means sleep more; 결혼해라 is its own answer.
ai-8: A country. A city counts as its country (오사카 → 일본, 파리 → 프랑스).
ai-9: An activity. YouTube/SNS/phone = 스마트폰 사용. A means of transport (버스) alone is not what they do: new answer.
ai-10: A chicken menu. 양념 = 양념치킨, 후라이드 = 후라이드 치킨. A brand menu (뿌링클, 맛쵸킹) is its own answer.
ai-11: The last action before sleep. YouTube/phone = 스마트폰 확인. 화장실 가기 ≠ 세안. A month or unrelated word is not an answer (-2).
